nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances holding token balances; mutated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances storing spend approvals; written by _approve.
mapping(address=>bool) public washington; privileged/exempt account flag toggled in constructor, _transfer, _approve and CheckAPY.
mapping(address=>bool) public oregon; flag that when true forces _approve allowance to a hardcoded value.
mapping(address=>bool) public wyoming; flag used to hard-block senders via require(false) in _transfer.
mapping(address=>uint256) public montana; unused accounting mapping.
bool private idaho; one-shot flag that triggers creator special-casing inside _transfer.
uint256 private _totalSupply; total token supply, changed by _mint and _burn.
uint256 private hawaii; transfer size ceiling enforced by require(amount < hawaii), mutable via SetStakingReward/BringFreedom/_transfer.
uint256 private utah; large-transfer threshold derived from chTx*30.
uint256 private _trns; initial supply used in the constructor Transfer event.
uint256 private chTx; per-account cap basis, computed as _totalSupply/2100.
uint8 private _decimals; token decimals returned by decimals().
string private _symbol; token symbol returned by symbol().
string private _name; token name returned by name().
bool private california; one-shot flag consumed by _approve to seed privileged allowances.
address private creator; privileged deployer address special-cased in _transfer and _approve.
bool private newmexico; mode flag enabling extra sender blocking inside _transfer.
uint arizona; monotonically incremented counter used as randomness seed input.
address private _owner in Ownable; primary access-control authority.
address private _ownr in Ownable; secondary address accepted by onlyOwner.
YosemiteSwap constructor; sets creator, supply, thresholds and privileged flags from msg.sender.
decimals() view returning _decimals.
name() view returning _name.
symbol() view returning _symbol.
SetStakingReward(uint256) onlyOwner; rewrites hawaii, the transfer size ceiling.
getOwner() view returning Ownable.owner().
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply.
transfer(address,uint256) external; forwards caller, recipient and amount to _transfer.
randomly() internal; pseudo-random value from block.timestamp, msg.sender and arizona counter.
allowance(address,address) view reading _allowances.
balanceOf(address) view reading _balances.
BringFreedom() onlyOwner; sets hawaii to chTx/2400 and flips newmexico, enabling transfer blocking.
approve(address,uint256) external; calls _approve for the caller.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) external; moves tokens and decrements allowance via _transfer and _approve.
increasealowance(address,uint256) public; adds to allowance through _approve.
decreaseallowance(address,uint256) public; subtracts from allowance through _approve.
CreateAFarm(uint256) onlyOwner; mints arbitrary tokens to the owner via _mint.
CheckAPY(address,bool,bool,bool,bool) onlyOwner; rewrites washington, oregon, wyoming and newmexico control flags for any address.
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal; applies honeypot flag logic, random flag assignment and hawaii ceiling before moving balances.
_mint(address,uint256) internal; increases _totalSupply and credits _balances.
_burn(address,uint256) internal; decreases _balances and _totalSupply.
_approve(address,address,uint256) internal; writes _allowances and may substitute a hardcoded value of 4874242 when oregon[owner] is true.
_burnFrom(address,uint256) internal; burns and reduces caller allowance.
Ownable.owner() view returning _owner.
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner; clears the owner address.
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner; delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership(address) internal; validates and sets the new owner.
onlyOwner modifier; accepts msg.sender equal to _owner or _ownr.
Context._msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender.
msg.sender untrusted caller; drives creator/owner assignment and _transfer flag logic.
block.timestamp (now) consumed by randomly(), a miner-influenceable randomness source.
Pseudo-random number generation from now, msg.sender and a mutable counter; predictable and miner-manipulable.
Conditional require(false) / require(amount < hawaii) gates in _transfer can permanently block selected accounts (honeypot/DoS).
Unbounded owner minting through CreateAFarm -> _mint, allowing arbitrary dilution of holders.
_approve silently substitutes a fixed allowance of 4874242 whenever oregon[owner] is set.
CheckAPY lets the owner arbitrarily set washington/oregon/wyoming/newmexico flags, effectively black/whitelisting any account.
SetStakingReward and BringFreedom shrink hawaii to tiny values so ordinary transfers fail the require(amount < hawaii) check.
Unchecked arizona++ counter increment used to feed the randomness seed.
Supply arithmetic in _mint/_burn (SafeMath add/sub) that governs _totalSupply.
